definitions.explanation: A pricing method where the displayed price already includes consumption tax.

examples.japanese: ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内税|うちぜい}です。
{内税|うちぜい}⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: The tax-inclusive display makes it easy to understand.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦お{店|みせ}→お店：21164_omise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内税|うちぜい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{外税|そとぜい}→外税：10262_sotozei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混在|こんざい}→混在：13352_konzai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This store has both tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive prices.

notes:
{内税|うちぜい} refers to a pricing method where the displayed price already includes ⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧ (consumption tax). This is what shoppers actually pay at the register.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {内税|うちぜい}/⟦{税込|ぜいこみ}→税込：09559_zeikomi⟧: tax-inclusive (what you see is what you pay)
- ⟦{外税|そとぜい}→外税：10262_sotozei⟧/⟦{税抜|ぜいぬき}→税抜：09560_zeinuki⟧: tax-exclusive (tax added at checkout)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {内税|うちぜい}⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧: tax-inclusive price display
- ⟦{税込|ぜいこみ}→税込：09559_zeikomi⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: tax-included price
- ⟦{総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}→総額表示：24007_sougakuhyouji⟧: total amount display (official term)

JAPAN CONTEXT:
Since April 2021, Japan requires businesses to display ⟦{総額表示|そうがくひょうじ}→総額表示：24007_sougakuhyouji⟧ (total price including tax) as the primary price. Before this, many stores showed ⟦{外税|そとぜい}→外税：10262_sotozei⟧ (tax-exclusive) prices, which confused shoppers.

USAGE:
⟦{税込|ぜいこみ}→税込：09559_zeikomi⟧ (tax-included) is used more often than {内税|うちぜい} in everyday speech and on price tags.
